page.notes: Page number and running head read clearly. Line numbers 10 to 60 in the right margin are printed margin text and are transcribed as notes; their exact line positions are approximate. The left marginal note is set in bold italic. Several word-level readings are uncertain: "qua[?]" (the abbreviated mark after "Sane"), and the paragraph break before "Sciô postea" is judged from a short line end. Small reference signs (a stray "s" after "Ro." and "ȷ" marks in the text) are not transcribed as text. The line "Certe Nicolai II." is printed "Nicolai I I." in the scan and is given here in the usual form. The italic passage and "Damasus Papa" passage are set in italic or bold italic and are rendered as italic. Two spellings "cō-tendit" and "Cōsiliarii" follow the printed abbreviations as read.
